purpose: Create one source-only cute V9 Daily-down reflection pose that does not resemble two lower white holes.

reference.usage: The locked V9 image is the sole generator reference. All previous V36 down attempts remain audit history and are not prompt inputs.

output_contract.format: one unlabelled 200x200-equivalent V9 Daily-down source face
output_contract.pixel_intent: clean monochrome black ink on plain white; no grey, color, texture or shading
output_contract.allowed_change: only the enclosed white large glossy oval and small four-point companion sparkle inside each existing open black eye silhouette
output_contract.down_geometry: the original V9 vertically elongated primary oval and its small diamond remain one close group, settle gently in the lower-middle without reaching the eye bottom, and retain a generous continuous black lower rim; the diamond sits adjacent on the lower-inner side
protected_identity: V9 outer black eye silhouette, placement and scale

forbidden: new outer eye silhouette, eye size or eye placement
new brow, mouth, cheek or charm art
legacy art, custom LUT, code-drawn eye, activation, provisioning or firmware flash
required_machine_gates_before_use: native-200 down distinction without lower-disc morphology
